messages.text: If I order qty 2 Hammer Miner BC04 today will I have them in my possession before Thanksgiving?
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner BC04

Very likely, yes, if you're in the US. The BC04 is in stock at our US warehouse right now, with plenty for two, and it ships within 2 business days. Order today and they should leave by Thursday, November 19. That gives the carrier a full week before Thanksgiving on the 26th.

I can't promise the delivery day itself. Transit time depends on your address and the shipping option you choose, and checkout shows both. They're $215 each right now, $430 for the pair.

Want me to set up a cart with two?
